basic_profile.bio: I'm a 41-year-old microbiologist based in Portland, Oregon. My passion revolves around the science of fermentation, which I often explore both professionally and as a hobby. When I'm not working in a lab, I'm experimenting with different fermentation techniques at home. I also have a keen interest in industrial hygiene, which ties into my day job. I enjoy sailing on the weekends and often participate in local regattas. My typical online hours are late evenings, as I wind down after a day of work and outdoor activities. Currently, I'm in a committed relationship with someone who shares my love for science and the outdoors.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a master's degree in microbiology and have been working in the field for over a decade. My interest in fermentation began during my college years, where I took specialized courses and conducted research on microbial processes. I've continued to expand my knowledge through self-study and practical experimentation at home.
